why: Tests step for slice 5 of the mock sweep in next/apps/fabrika/src (plan docs/plan/quests/mock-app-src-PLAN.md on fabrikalfa/mock-plans, decision 0555), in next/. Before, the folder held 43 vi.mock, vi.doMock and vi.stubEnv calls on origin/main at b5b68d315 (the plan counted 40 at 0683861; PR 1366 added runtime-quotas.laws.test.ts with three more). This step rewrote 34 of them out of 14 test files: the built table (virtual:fabrika-built, 8) and ./table.ts (4) are handed to the runtime by each law; the door, project-runtime and gateway mocks of runtime.decode.test.ts (3) go, since the law reads the exported inputName; the local-instance mock of file-services (1) becomes a start function handed to dev.ts's exported main; the compiler mock (1) was dead and goes; the node/build mock (1) and the rolldown mock of exam/bytes.integration.test.ts (1) become a Bundler service the law provides; the two @effect/platform-node mocks go, since each entry exports its command as main(args); the 13 vi.stubEnv calls go, 9 in file-services by a ConfigProvider the law provides and 4 in instance-one-file and local-instance because no code those laws reach reads the names (each law hands its home in as `home`). 9 stay: effect (slice 3), 4 Alchemy and 4 cloudflare:workers (0042). Every law was run green against a scratch prototype of the build's product change, then the prototype was removed; on main's product the changed plain files are red because runtime.ts still imports virtual:fabrika-built and grant.ts still calls NodeRuntime.runMain at import. instance-one-file and local-instance need no product change and are green on main.
